d: KFC's plans to expand into Italy's Dolomites have sparked a backlash from locals who say the American fast-food chain has no place in the country's iconic ski resorts. The proposal to open outlets in Cortina d'Ampezzo and Madonna di Campiglio has triggered threats of legal action and concerns over the commercialisation of the Alps. The move has also become a flashpoint in Italy's food culture debate. Palki Sharma tells you more.
